nf_webhook_hint: Discord: paste the webhook URL from „Integrations → Webhooks". Custom: any target - optionally with your own headers (e.g. an API key) and your own body format.
nf_smtp_hint: The RMM sends emails from the notification rules over this connection (e.g. „warranty expiring → mail to …").
nf_rule_hint: Example: „warranty expiring soon" on clients X, Y and Z → email to user@gmail.de. Or: „client goes offline" → webhook. Every rule has a built-in cooldown against alert storms.
nf_no_rules: No rules yet. Create the first one above.
